query.description: Specify the country code of the alerts request. This is a required parameter. The reference for acceptable values is ISO 3166 two-letter codes (alpha-2). example: US
Specify the language the language to use in the text values of the alert. Values should follow RFC 3066. example: en-US
Specify the source of the alerts request. example: NWS
When specified, the API will return only alerts that match the specified event types. example: Flood Warning
When specified, the API will return only alerts that match the specified event types. example: Flood Warning
Specify the date and time alerts are sent. When set, all alerts sent from this timestamp are returned. ISO8601 date-time format specified int RFC 3339. example: 2022-11-25T00:00:00
Specify the date and time alerts are sent. When set, all alerts sent until this timestamp are returned. ISO8601 date-time format specified int RFC 3339. example: 2022-11-26T00:00:00
Specify whether or not to include the geojson geometry for each alert.
Specify whether or not to include total number of alerts.
